text: Account Fees Schedule: Monthly maintenance fee $5.00, waived with a $500 minimum balance. Card replacement fee $10.00. Overdraft fee $35.00 per item. Contact support for the full fee schedule.

Mortgage FAQ: What is a monthly payment? Your monthly mortgage payment is deducted from your linked checking account. Contact your account manager to reschedule a payment or ask about your deposit history.
Branch Hours and Contact: Our branches are open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Call our support line at 1-800-555-0100 or visit any branch during business hours for account assistance.
